landing.hero_eyebrow: The gift that tells your story
landing.hero_text: An NFC keyring that opens a page of memories: photos, music and a dedication. Elegant, personal — nothing to download.
landing.story_heading: Not a gadget. A memory to keep close.
landing.story_p1: A gift that looks beautiful — and feels even better: they hold their phone close and discover the story you prepared together.
landing.story_p2: Made for the bonds that matter: a tangible gift that holds emotion and brings it back with every tap.
landing.how_lede: Nothing to download. It works with the phone already in your pocket.
landing.how_1_text: Choose the NFC object you prefer. Every product includes access to your personal editor and an activation code.
landing.how_2_text: Open the editor and personalize your page with photos, videos, playlists, letters, voice notes, dedications, special dates and much more.
landing.how_3_text: Whoever receives the gift just holds their smartphone to the NFC object to open the page you created. No app to download — just a memory to live.
landing.featured_text: Choose your Moments, prepare your page and gift an emotion that opens again with every tap.
landing.featured_setup_note: More designs coming soon. Explore the Moments available now.
landing.prop_1_text: Hold the phone close and the story opens: photos, music, a dedication. A gift that truly surprises.
landing.prop_2_text: Update memories anytime: new photos, a song, a message. The Moments stays — the story grows.
landing.prop_3_text: Anniversaries, birthdays, weddings or simply “because I’m thinking of you”: a gift that lasts and keeps telling your story.
landing.prop_4_text: Photos, music and a dedication in a space of your own: the story opens with a tap, whenever you want to relive it.
landing.faq_1_a: Choose a Moments, prepare the page with photos, music and a dedication, then gift it. A tap with the phone and the story opens.
landing.faq_2_a: No. They hold their phone to the Moments piece and the page opens right away. For older phones, a QR Code is available too.
landing.faq_3_q: What can I put on the Moments page?
landing.faq_3_a: Photos, music, a dedication and the memories that matter — the Moments page is the heart of the gift.
landing.faq_4_q: Can I change the memories later?
landing.faq_4_a: Yes. Update the page anytime: new moments, new feelings — same magic at a tap.
landing.faq_5_a: For the people you love and the ones who matter: a personal NFC gift for every bond and every important occasion.
landing.cta_text: Choose your Moments, create the memory page and gift an emotion that opens again with every tap.
